title: Dispatch: olc5.11 single-lifetime machine terminations + start_effect item-power duration binding (attempt 1)
description:
Implements capability eshyra-olc5.11 as RE-SCOPED by the user 2026-10-13 (read eshyra-olc5.11 notes in full, parent eshyra-olc5 capability contract, bd recall magic-item-faithful-or-absent). Branch eshyra-olc5.11.1 cut from eshyra-olc5.11 (= origin/main after the olc5.10 PR merges; cut SHA recorded at dispatch).

PART A - single-lifetime item state machines (21 kept machines in the pack: Animated Shield, Boots of Speed, Cloak of the Bat, Cube of Force, Dagger of Venom, Flame Tongue, Gem of Brightness, Glamoured Studded Leather, Immovable Rod, Ioun Stone, Potion of Diminution, Potion of Gaseous Form, Potion of Growth, Ring of Invisibility, Ring of Mind Shielding, Rod of Alertness, Rope of Entanglement, Staff of the Woodlands, Sun Blade, Sword of Sharpness, Wings of Flying).
CURRENT STATE (verified by captain): mechanics.stateMachine {initial, states, transitions[{from,to, via:<operationId> | timer:{amount,unit} | condition:<printed text>}], duration?, termination?}. use_item fires `via` transitions; timers resolve through itemResetExecutor resolveDueItemClockEvents + itemTimers.ts (round-unit timers currently fail closed: "requires the encounter-round scheduler"). NOTHING fires `condition` transitions (only Dagger of Venom types one: "an attack using this weapon hits a creature"). Several printed terminations are untyped, e.g. Animated Shield "until you are incapacitated or die", Ring of Invisibility "until the ring is removed, until you attack or cast a spell". Because use_item now spends the operation's typed turn resource (olc5.9), the DM must NOT end a state by calling a voluntary off-operation when the printed termination is an external event.
A1. CENSUS (required, committed as reviewed evidence like magicItemActivationCensus.json): for each kept machine, every printed way the active state ends or changes (quote the governing printed sentence verbatim): timer / operation / external condition. Mark each typed or missing. Also record round-unit timers.
A2. Type every missing printed external termination as a `condition` transition carrying the verbatim printed condition text (faithful-or-absent: exact printed predicate, never invented; a termination that is ambiguous stays an adjudicated clause with its verbatim span - list these in notes). Importer change per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md; regenerate pack; verify-dnd5e-srd-pack + inventory --check.
A3. New DM tool (name per tool conventions, e.g. `item_state_event`) that fires a declared `condition` transition on an item instance: input instanceId + the transition's condition (or a stable id you derive) + character; validates it is declared from the current state; applies the transition (cancelling/reconciling timers exactly as other transitions do, and firing olc5.8 cooldown anchors via applyCooldownAnchorToState for state-entered); spends NO turn resource and NO economy; fails closed on undeclared/ambiguous condition. Tool description: use it when the printed external event occurs; DM judges whether the event occurred.
A4. Round-unit timers: if any kept machine needs one, either implement through the existing encounter-round scheduler if one exists, or leave fail-closed and list it (do not invent).

PART B - start_effect binding for item powers.
CURRENT STATE: start_effect (packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolStartEffect.ts) accepts source {kind:'spell'|'magic-item'|..., ref}; kind 'spell' binds duration/concentration to the spell record. Find exactly how, then make kind 'magic-item' with an item ref + an effect ref (add the effect-ref input if absent, following the spell pattern) validate the started effect's duration (and concentration if typed) against the TYPED duration on that item effect in the pack; mismatch -> refused. An item effect with no typed duration -> no binding (DM-adjudicated, say so in the result). Pack prerequisite per the re-scope: every multi-instance item power effect carries its printed duration as a typed field - VERIFY this against the pack and list any item power effect lacking it (do not invent durations; report them).

READINESS: the stateMachine clauses carry the generic hook bundle F2 'activation action economy' + F5 'item state transition and duration processing' + F9 'targeting, escape, and movement consequences'. Do NOT land hooks whose contract the runtime does not fully own for every carrier. If you conclude the stateMachine clause's hook set is wrong for a machine (e.g. F9 on a light toggle), report it with evidence; changing hook assignments is a pack change that needs that per-machine evidence in the census. Report the exact ready-operation delta (deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady over all combos, before/after) with a faithfulness note per newly-ready op.

CONFORMANCE TESTS (pack records): Animated Shield activate -> incapacitated condition ends it with no turn spend; Dagger of Venom coat -> hit condition uncoats; Wings of Flying condition/timer paths still anchor the olc5.8 cooldown; undeclared condition refused; Potion of Growth dice timer still resolves; start_effect for an item power with typed duration accepts the matching duration and refuses a mismatch; item effect without typed duration is unbound.

Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: census summary (typed/added/adjudicated per machine), tool design, start_effect binding design, item-power effects lacking typed duration, hooks landed or not, exact ready delta.
notes:
Cut from origin/main 253cc201 (PR #662 merged: held state + equipment DNF check now in useItem).
Dispatched gpt-6-luna effort high; PGID 4039128.
Implemented and committed as 959855a8 on branch eshyra-olc5.11.1. Added the zero-cost item_state_event tool and transactional state-condition transition executor; transitions require an exact declared condition, clear timers from the state being left, schedule destination timers, and apply state-entry cooldown anchors. Added item-effect source binding to start_effect, migration 0045 for active_effect.source_effect_ref, and validation against the referenced item effect duration and concentration requirements. Imported source-faithful termination conditions for the scoped single-lifetime item state machines and generated magicItemStateTerminationCensus.json. No round-unit state-machine timers were required; existing round-unit budget mechanics remain distinct. Added typed finite spell duration binding for operation-linked castSpell item effects, retaining item-specific printed durations; 93 finite effects are covered. Externally ended Helm of Brilliance weapon-flame duration remains unbound because the printed lifetime is event-based, not a typed clock. Dice-based spell durations remain explicitly unbound pending deterministic roll evidence; follow-up eshyra-p3dq tracks this. No readiness changes: operation-ready comparison remains 1 ready and 60 refused, with zero newly ready or newly unready. Updated source-agreement audit to allow only exact duration amount/unit inherited from the referenced typed spell record. Regenerated rules pack and semi-structured inventory; importer verification and inventory check passed. Full npm run verify:worktree passed before commit: 363 test files passed, 2 skipped; 6778 tests passed, 3 skipped. No changes to parent beads. Commit left unpushed for dispatch handoff.
